ahrc.definition: The quality that distinguishes a vital and functional being from a dead body; life. Literally the stomach. Used idiomatically of living creatures, especially in conjunction with land, ground or field. Alternate Translations: life (when in the plural form); creature (as a living one)
To stay in a dwelling place for the night or for long periods of time; to sit down.
To put in proper condition or readiness. Alternate Translations: be ready (when written in the niphil [passive] form); estblish (when written in the piel [intensive] form)
